Backtest (honest; simulated, not live trades): HistData M1 BID bars Apr-Sep 2026 (6 months, 13 crosses; only bid M1 data exists on the box - no historical ask or ticks; live median spreads from the 10/8 reality check used as cost). Filled in the SAME minute as the gap: 655 trades, net +50.22 USD, 52.7% green, PF 1.36 (A 40 trades +13.01; Z 615 trades +37.21). Filled ONE minute later: 634 trades, net -65.05 USD, 45.3% green, PF 0.61. So the gaps exist (about 5 a day across the 13 crosses) but the edge is gone if the fill is ~1 minute late; live fills take ~5-10 s through the terminal, so expect somewhere in between and likely around break-even or worse. M1 closes are not simultaneous across pairs, which makes the same-minute result optimistic. Armed anyway on Owner order 1:19 PM ET 10/8.
Reality check (read-only scan, no orders) (1:23–1:43 PM ET 10/8, 20 min, 379 reads of 13 crosses): 379 live reads over 20 min (median read 802 ms). A cross's gap beat its own cost (spread + commission) on 23.0% of cross-reads, but almost all of that is a STANDING broker offset, not a passing mistake: EURCAD -3.1 p on 100% of reads, CADJPY +2.2 p on 100% of reads, AUDCAD -1.9 p on 100% of reads (USDCAD.sim is priced ~2.5 p away from what EURCAD, AUDCAD and CADJPY imply, all the time). Fresh gaps beyond cost + 0.5 p: 0.0% of cross-reads. Under the armed rules the window would have fired trigger A 0 time(s) and trigger Z 0 time(s) (counted per read, so one episode can count several times). Every other cross: median gap 0.11 p vs cost 1.66 p. |z| reached 3+ on 12 of 13 crosses (biggest: AUDJPY z -4.3, EURAUD -4.0, EURCHF -3.8), but those moves were only 0.3-1.0 pip while cost was 1.1-2.8 pips, so none was big enough to pay for the trade. Expect very few trades.

0.01 lot · tag MISTAKE1 · Pricing-mistake hunter (FX version of two-pool arbitrage; no direction guess). Every ~3 s it reads the broker's own bid/ask for the 7 USD majors and 13 crosses from the MT5 terminal, works out what each cross SHOULD cost from its two USD legs (e.g. EURJPY = EURUSD x USDJPY), and measures the gap in pips. Trigger A (absolute mistake): the gap is bigger than the cross's spread + the $0.06 commission (in pips) + 0.5 pip safety, on 2 reads in a row, and it is NEW (a gap that has sat there for the last ~10 min is a standing broker offset, not a mistake - e.g. USDCAD.sim runs ~2.5 pips above what the CAD crosses imply). Trigger Z (statistical): the gap is 3+ standard deviations from its own ~10-minute average AND that move beats spread + commission. It then trades ONLY the cross, 0.01 lot (broker minimum), in the direction that closes the gap. Exit: as soon as the gap closes (back to zero for A, back to its average for Z) and the trade is at least +$0.01 after commission; or Jim's ladder (peak +$0.03 locks +$0.01, +$0.09 -> $0.045, +$0.15 -> $0.10, +$0.30 -> $0.15, +$0.50 -> $0.25, +$1.00 -> $0.80, above $1 keeps 80%; checked every ~3 s, closes at market); or 15 minutes; or the broker hard stop at 2x the entry gap (at least 2x spread + 1 pip, max $1). Max 3 open, 1 per cross. Auto-stop at -$150 or 5 losses in a row. All hours FX is open; Friday 4:50 PM ET flatten (no entries after 4:35). FTMO guards: equity below day-start - $8,000 or below $182,000 -> flatten, no entries. · runner not running · placing OFF · last check Fri 10/9 5:53 PM ET

0.1 BTC (BTCUSD.sim) lot · tag C-DESK1 · CRYPTO COPY (sector Crypto, Jim 9:23 PM ET Fri 10/9/2026) of DESK1: same strategy logic on BTCUSD.sim (the only crypto CFD on this FTMO US account). Lot 0.1 BTC (smallest legal lot; FX 0.01 -> 0.1). Stops = the same ATR multiples, in BTC points ($1 = 1 point, $0.10 per point at 0.1 lot). Jim's net ladder x27 at 0.1 lot: +$0.81 -> lock $0.27, +$2.43 -> $1.22, +$4.05 -> $2.70, +$8.10 -> $4.05, +$13.50 -> $6.75, +$27 -> $21.60, then 80% of peak. Per-trade $ caps x27; test-level $ stops x10. Costs: broker spread + ~0.0325%/side commission (~$5.3 round turn). Entries 24/7 incl. weekends (no FX rollover / Friday rules), except platform maintenance. FTMO guards account-wide: flatten + no entries if equity < Prague day-start - $8,000 or < $182,000. FX rules it copies: Six-role desk, momentum flavor, 0.01 lot, 12 FX pairs, max 3 open. TESS: last hour's range (4 x M15) >= 2.5 x H1 ATR(14), then an M15 bar closes beyond the prior 20 M15 bars' high/low with body >= 0.8 x M15 ATR, closing in its outer 30%, and the last M5 bar agrees -> enter with the move (best expansion first). Stop 1.0 x M15 ATR; no-progress cut 45 min; max hold 240 min. HOLT (no economic calendar here): an M5 bar >= 4.0 x M5 ATR closing in its outer 25% -> continuation; stop = 1 x the spike range; cut 20 min; max 90 min. RIGO: hard stop <= $2 incl. commission. KETT: Jim's ladder (+$0.03 -> lock $0.01, $0.15 -> $0.10, $0.30 -> $0.15, $0.50 -> $0.25, $1 -> $0.80, then 80%), auto-stop -$150 closed or 5 losses in a row, FTMO guards, Friday flatten 4 PM ET. No entries 4:45-6:15 PM ET or Friday after 3:30 PM ET. · runner running · placing ON · last check Fri 10/9 10:03 PM ET

Volatility filter: skip when ATR(14) is in the top 20% of its last 100 bars. Boat (balance governor): max 4 open, 1 per pair, no more than 2 open trades leaning the same way on any one currency; while the test's total-if-closed is below $0 no new entries except one recovery trade when flat. Exits: hard stop 3 x ATR14 of the entry TF, never more than $2 incl. commission; Jim's trailing ladder with breathing room (+$0.03 -> lock $0.01, $0.15 -> $0.10, $0.30 -> $0.15, $0.50 -> $0.25, $1.00 -> $0.80, then 80% of peak); no-progress exit if +$0.03 not reached in 30 min; max hold 4 h; Friday 4:00 PM ET flatten. Auto-stop: -$150 closed or 5 losses in a row -> flatten and pause (awaiting orders). FTMO guards: equity < Prague day-start - $8,000 or < $182,000 -> flatten, no entries. Hours: all FX hours except 4:45-6:15 PM ET rollover; Friday no entries from 3:30 PM ET. Behaviour library: each pair|TF|setup is a behaviour; after >= 8 closes, net < $0 or < 60% green -> FAILED (benched, never traded again); net > $0 and >= 75% green -> PASSED (preferred). FX rules it copies: AI Consistent: no fixed strategy, only the goal (consistency score: MTM consistency >= 75%, median trade > $0, best trade < 50% of profit, total-if-closed > $0 on 80% of snapshots, losing streak <= 3, PF >= 1.3). Behaviour pool = 9 low-spread pairs x 62 recipes (PING1 V-turn, Co-op 1 settle, Basket v2.1 RSI(2) fade, RSI(2) dip in trend, AGGR1 V-turn in trend, z-score revert, momentum; M3-H1; all hours / 2-4 PM / London / NY; with and without the no-progress cut). Thompson sampling picks which firing behaviour to trade (draw of $ per trade > 0 and draw of green rate >= 60%, else 5% exploration while untested); PASSED / DEMOTED / FAILED from live results; mutated variants scored on history every 2 h while not consistent and every 6 h over the weekend. No own trading hours, no Friday cutoff or flatten, weekend holding and news trading allowed; entries pause only while the market itself is shut. Manager proposals and decisions

Manager round Fri 9:38:36 PM ET · 176.8 s thinking

Analysis: BTCUSD has high transaction costs (~$25 spread + $0.57 per 0.01 BTC), making tiny edges unviable. Existing strategies show consistent negative returns after costs, especially in longer timeframes and with aggressive stops. To improve consistency, we must focus on high-probability, low-volatility, time-of-day-optimized entries with tight stops and minimal progress exits. The best-performing families (like RF|M15|PM) show moderate green rates but negative expectancy—suggesting we need to refine entry timing and volatility filtering to avoid costly false signals.
Lesson added to research notes: In crypto, high volatility and cost structure make edge preservation more critical than raw edge size; optimal strategies must prioritize low-volatility, high-probability windows with minimal exposure to slippage and noise.

CRYPTO COPY (sector Crypto, Jim 9:23 PM ET Fri 10/9/2026) of AICON: same strategy logic on BTCUSD.sim (the only crypto CFD on this FTMO US account). Lot 0.1 BTC (smallest legal lot; FX 0.01 -> 0.1). Stops = the same ATR multiples, in BTC points ($1 = 1 point, $0.10 per point at 0.1 lot). Jim's net ladder x27 at 0.1 lot: +$0.81 -> lock $0.27, +$2.43 -> $1.22, +$4.05 -> $2.70, +$8.10 -> $4.05, +$13.50 -> $6.75, +$27 -> $21.60, then 80% of peak. Per-trade $ caps x27; test-level $ stops x10. Costs: broker spread + ~0.0325%/side commission (~$5.3 round turn). Entries 24/7 incl. weekends (no FX rollover / Friday rules), except platform maintenance. FTMO guards account-wide: flatten + no entries if equity < Prague day-start - $8,000 or < $182,000. C-AICON keeps AICON's no-cap rules (FTMO guards only) and its own AI brain copy (crypto/aicon/brain). FX rules it copies: AI Consistent: no fixed strategy, only the goal (consistency score: MTM consistency >= 75%, median trade > $0, best trade < 50% of profit, total-if-closed > $0 on 80% of snapshots, losing streak <= 3, PF >= 1.3). Behaviour pool = 9 low-spread pairs x 62 recipes (PING1 V-turn, Co-op 1 settle, Basket v2.1 RSI(2) fade, RSI(2) dip in trend, AGGR1 V-turn in trend, z-score revert, momentum; M3-H1; all hours / 2-4 PM / London / NY; with and without the no-progress cut). Thompson sampling picks which firing behaviour to trade (draw of $ per trade > 0 and draw of green rate >= 60%, else 5% exploration while untested); PASSED / DEMOTED / FAILED from live results; mutated variants scored on history every 2 h while not consistent and every 6 h over the weekend. Lot: starts 0.01, its own lot engine promotes on proven steady results and drops immediately on 2 reds in a row or negative total-if-closed; only PASSED behaviours get the promoted lot. Its own current choices: max 6 open, 1 per pair, 2 per currency side, stop = behaviour's ATR multiple capped at its cap per 0.01, Jim's ladder with 2 x ATR(M1) breathing room, learned per-behaviour time exits (soft); defensive (top-ranked only, one at a time, 0.01) while total-if-closed < 0. Only FTMO rules bind (Owner 6:51 AM ET 10/9: no time limits, no own caps): FTMO max daily loss $10,000 from the Prague day-start balance and max loss $20,000 ($180,000 floor), enforced by our guard firing first (equity < day-start - $8,000 or < $182,000 -> flatten, no entries); open risk at stops never more than the headroom to that guard; legal broker sizes only. No own trading hours, no Friday cutoff or flatten, weekend holding and news trading allowed; entries pause only while the market itself is shut. Its own soft choices (it may change them): max 6 open, 2 per currency side, a 25%-of-headroom risk budget for promoted lots, per-behaviour time exits. Tag AICON. AI brain (Owner 6:51 AM ET 10/9): local models on this box, no human or API keys needed - Chronos-Bolt forecaster (next 60 min per pair, every minute), financial-news sentiment on free headline feeds + Forex Factory calendar + CFTC COT, and a local Qwen3-4B manager that every 4 h reads its adaptation log, library, research notes and news, proposes new behaviours, and adopts them only if they beat the incumbent on hidden holdout data after costs. Forecast / news filters veto trades only when the backtest shows edge; otherwise their values are recorded on every decision (shadow).

Manager proposals and decisions

Manager round Fri 3:15:37 PM ET · 357.3 s thinking

Analysis: The current strategy suffers from poor consistency in MTM green rate and total-if-closed performance due to high-frequency false signals and inadequate volatility filtering. Existing RF/M30 PM rules work in low-spread pairs but fail to adapt to news-driven spikes or sudden trend shifts. A more resilient edge requires volatility-aware entry timing, tighter stop logic, and trend confirmation via volume or momentum alignment. We propose new behaviours that combine volatility filtering with trend confirmation to reduce false entries and improve edge survival after costs.
Lesson added to research notes: Volatility filtering (volf=true) combined with trend confirmation (e.g., RSI(2) fade against H4 trend) significantly reduces false breakouts in high-liquidity hours, improving both win/loss balance and net profitability after costs.

Live test — open-ended (no end time)

Armed Fri 6:35:17 AM ET; runs until Jim says otherwise. Now: LIVE
AI Consistent: no fixed strategy, only the goal (consistency score: MTM consistency >= 75%, median trade > $0, best trade < 50% of profit, total-if-closed > $0 on 80% of snapshots, losing streak <= 3, PF >= 1.3). Behaviour pool = 9 low-spread pairs x 62 recipes (PING1 V-turn, Co-op 1 settle, Basket v2.1 RSI(2) fade, RSI(2) dip in trend, AGGR1 V-turn in trend, z-score revert, momentum; M3-H1; all hours / 2-4 PM / London / NY; with and without the no-progress cut). Thompson sampling picks which firing behaviour to trade (draw of $ per trade > 0 and draw of green rate >= 60%, else 5% exploration while untested); PASSED / DEMOTED / FAILED from live results; mutated variants scored on history every 2 h while not consistent and every 6 h over the weekend. Lot: starts 0.01, its own lot engine promotes on proven steady results and drops immediately on 2 reds in a row or negative total-if-closed; only PASSED behaviours get the promoted lot. Its own current choices: max 6 open, 1 per pair, 2 per currency side, stop = behaviour's ATR multiple capped at its cap per 0.01, Jim's ladder with 2 x ATR(M1) breathing room, learned per-behaviour time exits (soft); defensive (top-ranked only, one at a time, 0.01) while total-if-closed < 0. Only FTMO rules bind (Owner 6:51 AM ET 10/9: no time limits, no own caps): FTMO max daily loss $10,000 from the Prague day-start balance and max loss $20,000 ($180,000 floor), enforced by our guard firing first (equity < day-start - $8,000 or < $182,000 -> flatten, no entries); open risk at stops never more than the headroom to that guard; legal broker sizes only. No own trading hours, no Friday cutoff or flatten, weekend holding and news trading allowed; entries pause only while the market itself is shut. Its own soft choices (it may change them): max 6 open, 2 per currency side, a 25%-of-headroom risk budget for promoted lots, per-behaviour time exits. Tag AICON. AI brain (Owner 6:51 AM ET 10/9): local models on this box, no human or API keys needed - Chronos-Bolt forecaster (next 60 min per pair, every minute), financial-news sentiment on free headline feeds + Forex Factory calendar + CFTC COT, and a local Qwen3-4B manager that every 4 h reads its adaptation log, library, research notes and news, proposes new behaviours, and adopts them only if they beat the incumbent on hidden holdout data after costs. Forecast / news filters veto trades only when the backtest shows edge; otherwise their values are recorded on every decision (shadow).

0.01 lot · tag XCLEAN · Xclean (strict control for Co-op 1, 0.01 lot FIXED). ONE frozen setup: M5 V-turn equilibrium after an M15 RSI(2) dip, 9 low-spread pairs. Entry = V-turn equilibrium: DIP (RSI(2) of the direction TF < 5 or > 95 in its last 3 bars and a 5-bar low/high), RISE (next bar closes through the dip bar by >= 0.2 x ATR, in its outer third, higher low/lower high), SETTLE (next bar holds above the turn bar's low/below its high, closes on the right side of its midpoint, range <= turn bar range), then ENTER at market. Volatility filter: skip when ATR(14) is in the top 20% of its last 100 bars. Boat (balance governor): max 4 open, 1 per pair, no more than 2 open trades leaning the same way on any one currency; while the test's total-if-closed is below $0 no new entries except one recovery trade when flat. Exits: hard stop 3 x ATR14 of the entry TF, never more than $2 incl. commission; Jim's trailing ladder with breathing room (+$0.03 -> lock $0.01, $0.15 -> $0.10, $0.30 -> $0.15, $0.50 -> $0.25, $1.00 -> $0.80, then 80% of peak); no-progress exit if +$0.03 not reached in 30 min; max hold 4 h; Friday 4:00 PM ET flatten. Auto-stop: -$150 closed or 5 losses in a row -> flatten and pause (awaiting orders). FTMO guards: equity < Prague day-start - $8,000 or < $182,000 -> flatten, no entries. Hours: all FX hours except 4:45-6:15 PM ET rollover; Friday no entries from 3:30 PM ET. NO learning library, NO mid-run rule changes: CONFIG + runner code + checklist are SHA-256 hashed at start and shown on the dashboard; any change is visible. 0.01 lot · tag COOP1 · Co-op 1 (consistency under pressure, 0.01 lot FIXED, no scaling). 9 low-spread pairs, two setups (M3 with M4 dip, M5 with M15 dip). Entry = V-turn equilibrium: DIP (RSI(2) of the direction TF < 5 or > 95 in its last 3 bars and a 5-bar low/high), RISE (next bar closes through the dip bar by >= 0.2 x ATR, in its outer third, higher low/lower high), SETTLE (next bar holds above the turn bar's low/below its high, closes on the right side of its midpoint, range <= turn bar range), then ENTER at market. Volatility filter: skip when ATR(14) is in the top 20% of its last 100 bars. Boat (balance governor): max 4 open, 1 per pair, no more than 2 open trades leaning the same way on any one currency; while the test's total-if-closed is below $0 no new entries except one recovery trade when flat. Exits: hard stop 3 x ATR14 of the entry TF, never more than $2 incl. commission; Jim's trailing ladder with breathing room (+$0.03 -> lock $0.01, $0.15 -> $0.10, $0.30 -> $0.15, $0.50 -> $0.25, $1.00 -> $0.80, then 80% of peak); no-progress exit if +$0.03 not reached in 30 min; max hold 4 h; Friday 4:00 PM ET flatten. Auto-stop: -$150 closed or 5 losses in a row -> flatten and pause (awaiting orders). FTMO guards: equity < Prague day-start - $8,000 or < $182,000 -> flatten, no entries. Hours: all FX hours except 4:45-6:15 PM ET rollover; Friday no entries from 3:30 PM ET. Behaviour library: each pair|TF|setup is a behaviour; after >= 8 closes, net < $0 or < 60% green -> FAILED (benched, never traded again); net > $0 and >= 75% green -> PASSED (preferred). Backtest (honest; simulated, not live trades): ALL-HOURS (live since 10/8 1:47 AM ET on Owner order 'Let them trade all hours anyway'; same rule, entries any hour except 4:45-6:15 PM ET and Friday after 3:30 PM): CLEARLY NEGATIVE - OUT-OF-SAMPLE Apr..Sep 2026 4569 trades, 35.1/day, 68.4% green, net -609.33, PF 0.698, max DD $613.23, worst $-6.34; in-sample 40.6/day, 69.4% green, net -1494.09, PF 0.73; full 18 months -2103.43. The auto-pause (net negative after 30 closes / 6 losses in a row / -$150) is expected to stop it early. EARLIER AFTERNOON-ONLY VERSION: PING1 research (shared backtest code: HistData M1 bid, Apr-2025..Sep-2026; costs: per-pair spread x session factor, $0.06 commission, 0.2 p entry slip, 0.3 p stop slip, swap; Owner's net trailing ladder simulated with a 1-bar delay and the breathing-room rule; SL checked before the trail moves inside each M1 bar; max 6 open, 1 per pair). OUT-OF-SAMPLE Apr..Sep 2026: 418 trades, 3.2/day, 66.0% green, net -26.88, PF 0.813, avg win $0.423 vs avg loss $1.012, max DD $39.29, worst $-5.3. In-sample Apr-2025..Mar-2026: 3.4/day, 70.3% green, net -27.71, PF 0.918, max DD $62.79. Spread x2 stress: IS -99.03 / OOS -38.45. HONEST: NEGATIVE. Every M1-M4 variant tested was net negative after costs (trend-direction V: PF 0.55-0.70, about -$200 to -$1,100 per 6 months); this is the least-bad tweak (V turn after an M4 stretch, afternoon only). With zero costs the plain V is about break-even, so the spread + $0.06 commission is what sinks it. Expected live: auto-pause after ~30 closes if still negative. Caveat: Yahoo M1/M3 bars are noisier than the broker feed for EURUSD/GBPUSD/AUDUSD/NZDUSD/USDCAD (RSI correlation ~0.6-0.8).
0.01 lot · tag PING1 · PING1 v1.1 (Owner's V on tiny timeframes): direction = snap-back after a stretched M4 bar (RSI(2) of M4 < 5 -> up, > 95 -> down, valid 3 M4 bars); entry at the M3 'V' turn - the previous M3 bar made the 5-bar low, this M3 bar is green, closes above the previous bar's high with a higher low -> BUY (inverted V -> SELL). 9 lowest-spread pairs, entries ALL HOURS FX is open (no entries 4:45-6:15 PM ET rollover or Friday after 3:30 PM); 0.01 lot, hard SL 20x ATR14(M3) (max $3), no fixed TP: Owner's net trailing ladder moves the broker SL up (+$0.03 -> lock $0.01 ... +$1 -> $0.80, then 80% of peak) with breathing room 3x ATR14(M1); time stop 8 h; max 6 open, 1 per pair; tag PING1 · runner not running · placing OFF · last check Fri 10/9 5:53 PM ET
Entry: a ‘V’ on tiny timeframes. First an M4 (4-minute) bar is stretched: RSI(2) below 5 means look for a bounce up, above 95 means look for a drop (valid for 3 M4 bars). Then on M3 (3-minute) bars: the previous bar made the lowest low of the last 5 bars, and the new bar is green, closes above the previous bar’s high with a higher low → BUY (upside-down V → SELL). Pairs: 9 lowest-spread pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, USDCHF, USDCAD, AUDUSD, NZDUSD, EURGBP, EURCHF). Hours: all hours FX is open, except no entries 4:45–6:15 PM ET (rollover) and Friday after 3:30 PM. Size: 0.01 lot, max 6 open, 1 per pair. Ladder: once a trade is up +$0.03 net it locks +$0.01, rising to lock $0.80 at +$1, then 80% of the peak; the broker SL is moved up (or a virtual lock closes at market). Stop: hard broker stop 20× ATR(M3), at most $3 loss; time stop 8 h. Auto-stop: pauses at −$150 closed, 6 losses in a row, or still negative after 30 closes (now: $147.92 room, 2 losses-in-a-row left).

What was wrong
  • Since the 8:56 PM ET re-arm: 5 closes at 0.05, -$3.18. The 3 green closes were only +$0.04, +$0.24 and +$0.04. The trailing lock fires about 0.4 pip after the peak, and the web close lag eats most of that (for example, trigger +$0.23 closed at +$0.05).
  • The 2 red closes were both 30-minute no-progress exits: USDJPY -$2.03 and EURGBP -$1.47. That exit closes at a loss before the trade has room. It was the worst exit in the backtest (as live: OOS PF 0.56, against 0.66 without it).
  • The lot ladder floor was 0.05, so a red close could never step the lot down. It started at 5x on an entry that is negative in the backtest.
  • It traded at all hours. The all-hours backtest is much worse than 2-4 PM ET.
What changed
  • 30-min no-progress exit removed.
  • New entries 2:00-4:00 PM ET only. No entries 4:45-6:15 PM ET or on Friday after 3:30 PM ET.
  • Lot ladder is 0.01-0.05-0.10-0.20-0.35-0.50. It starts at 0.01 and steps down to a 0.01 floor. It only steps up after the promotion gate is met (30+ trades, MTM consistency 75% or more, median above $0, best trade under 50% of profit).
  • Runner stopped and switch off since 5:42 AM ET 10/9. No trades were open.

Verdict: Still slightly negative after the fixes. Recommend: do not re-arm at 0.05+. If Jim wants it running, use 0.01 only.

What was wrong

  • Since the 8:56 PM ET re-arm: 5 closes at 0.05, -$3.18. The 3 green closes were only +$0.04, +$0.24 and +$0.04. The trailing lock fires about 0.4 pip after the peak, and the web close lag eats most of that (for example, trigger +$0.23 closed at +$0.05).
  • The 2 red closes were both 30-minute no-progress exits: USDJPY -$2.03 and EURGBP -$1.47. That exit closes at a loss before the trade has room. It was the worst exit in the backtest (as live: OOS PF 0.56, against 0.66 without it).
  • The lot ladder floor was 0.05, so a red close could never step the lot down. It started at 5x on an entry that is negative in the backtest.
  • It traded at all hours. The all-hours backtest is much worse than 2-4 PM ET.

What was changed

  • 30-min no-progress exit removed.
  • New entries 2:00-4:00 PM ET only. No entries 4:45-6:15 PM ET or on Friday after 3:30 PM ET.
  • Lot ladder is 0.01-0.05-0.10-0.20-0.35-0.50. It starts at 0.01 and steps down to a 0.01 floor. It only steps up after the promotion gate is met (30+ trades, MTM consistency 75% or more, median above $0, best trade under 50% of profit).
  • Runner stopped and switch off since 5:42 AM ET 10/9. No trades were open.

0.01 lot · tag AGGR1 · AGGR1 v1.5 (Owner 3:19 AM - active management, keep the book floating positive). ENTRY: only on a CONFIRMED V-turn in the trend - on M5, M15, M30 and H1 bar closes (M1 off: no reliable broker M1 bars), 20 pairs, all hours: the next-higher timeframe is trending (close above its EMA50 for buys, below for sells), price dipped at least 1 ATR and made a swing low (lowest of the last 5 bars), then the next bar closed ABOVE that bar's high with a higher low and an up close (mirror for sells). 0.01 lot. EXITS: profit -> Owner ladder locks fast from peak +$0.03 (lock $0.01 ... +$1 -> $0.80, then 80% of peak): a real broker SL at the lock whenever the broker allows (re-tried every 3 s), else a virtual lock that closes at lock + $0.03; no progress -> closed if it never reached +$0.03 within 20 min (M5) / 45 min (M15) / 90 min (M30) / 3 h (H1); too deep -> early cut at net -(max(1.5 x average win, $0.15) + 0.25 x ATR) (longer TFs a bit more room); max hold 2 h / 4 h / 6 h / 8 h; broker hard SL at 2x the cut as a backstop. GOVERNOR (v1.5 book = v1.5 closes + open trades): 1 probe trade at a time while the book is below $0 (and none while it is red), 2 at >= $0, +1 per +$0.25 green (max 10); no entries while more than half of open trades are red; a pair with an open trade losing > 3x the average win takes no new entry. LEARNING: results per pair x timeframe x setup; a bucket is switched OFF after >= 3 closes with net < 0 (or 2 closes, 0 green); better buckets are taken first; after 15 closes, if net < 0 and green $ < 45% of all $, the card flags METHOD REVIEW.
